description.value: Hope Pizza Place is a family-run pizzeria established in 2010 that has become a local favourite in Hope, BC. The restaurant prides itself on fresh, never-frozen ingredients and offers both pick-up and delivery. Hope sits at a key junction on cycling routes through the Fraser Valley and into the Interior, making this a convenient refuel stop.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and corroborates the OSM phone number exactly. The website confirms takeout/pick-up service explicitly ('Open for Pick-Up and Delivery!'), but makes no mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities.
